newsitem.title: UK: NWE bunkers steady to firmer, Med MDO/Diesel soft.
newsitem.headline: NWE bunkers steady to firmer, Med MDO/Diesel soft.

text.p: Bunker fuel prices were steady to firmer in most regions on Thursday though Mediterranean markets showed some weakness again despite tight supplies of some grades, brokers said.

In Rotterdam, high sulphur bunkers were trading around $186-$187 with lows sulphur barges done around $191-$192 and diesel in the $145 region. Brokers said trade was limited to very small pieces with buying interest still at a minimum.
Antwerp markets were valued around the same levels.
In Hamburg, fuel oil prices edged high matching the gains in ARA while MDO and gas oil bunkers were little changed. Dealers said there was a good supply of most product but buyers were scarce.

In the Mediterranean, prices of all grades at most ports were slightly weaker despite tighter supplies of MDO and gas oil at Spanish and French ports. Brokers had felt the market here was beginning to steady up but demand is still fairly relaxed.
Mideast Gulf and North African markets were mostly stable but the posted price for Jeddah liftings was marked down $1 to $93 for 180 cst bunkers MDO bunkers were unchanged.
